name: archhelp-claude-plugin
description: Scan any GitHub repository and generate technical architecture diagrams, data flow diagrams, ER diagrams, component maps, sequence diagrams, and deployment topologies — all rendered as Mermaid diagrams inline in Claude.

privacy.notes: The plugin fetches repository metadata and source file content from the GitHub REST API. No data is stored or forwarded to any service other than GitHub. The optional GITHUB_TOKEN is read from the environment and never logged or included in tool responses.

permissions.reason: Required to fetch repository file trees and source content for analysis.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub Personal Access Token. Increases API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 req/hr. Requires read:repo scope. Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens
